formations.title: AI Starter
formations.description: Level 1: Introduction to Generative Artificial Intelligence
formations.description_lg: Discover how generative artificial intelligence can transform your professional daily life! This accessible training will introduce you to tools such as ChatGPT and DALL·E to boost creativity and productivity. In addition to technical mastery, you will address essential ethical practices for responsible use. At the end of the session, you will have the basics to integrate generative AI into your daily work in an informed and effective way.
learnList: Understand the key concepts of generative artificial intelligence.
Discover and master generative AI tools like ChatGPT and DALL·E.
Identify use cases for generative AI in your professional environment.
Reflect on ethical best practices and limitations of generative AI.
public_cible: Business Leaders and Managers: Discover the basics of generative AI to simplify certain tasks and improve business operations.
Executives and Managers: Get introduced to generative AI tools to start exploring benefits in terms of team creativity and productivity.
Freelancers and Entrepreneurs: Discover how AI can help save time and simplify aspects of daily work.
Students: Acquire basic AI knowledge to enrich their skills and explore new opportunities in their academic journey.
prerequisites: No prior knowledge is required to attend the AI Starter training.

formations.title: AI Performer
formations.description: Level 2: Advanced use and prompt engineering
formations.description_lg: We adopt an interactive approach to ensure complete understanding of theoretical and practical concepts. Each session combines clear explanations, live demonstrations and practical exercises to ensure you will be able to implement generative AI in your projects by the end of the training.
formations.resources: Course materials, access to AI tools for 3 months, 2 individual coaching sessions
learnList: Master the main features of ChatGPT and its various options.
Ability to use ChatGPT for various tasks (writing, assistance, automation).
Introduction to creating effective prompts to improve interactions with ChatGPT.
Using ChatGPT in different professional contexts to boost productivity.
Preparation for advanced prompt engineering techniques.
public_cible: Business Leaders and Managers: Deepen knowledge of generative AI to maximize profitability with advanced use cases.
Executives and Managers: Learn to create and refine effective prompts that improve results and optimize work time.
Freelancers and Entrepreneurs: Acquire specific skills to stand out through our introduction to prompt engineering.
Students: Enrich your practices and knowledge of generative AI with tools such as Perplexity.
prerequisites: Knowledge of basic principles and tools is necessary to attend the AI Performer training.

formations.title: AI Master
formations.description: Level 3: Expertise and advanced integration of generative AI
formations.description_lg: Explore advanced AI applications in this intensive and practical training. You will learn to design complex prompts, develop personalized solutions and automate your workflows. Based on real scenarios and interactive exercises, this session will allow you to refine your skills through practical workshops and advanced simulations. Explore advanced AI applications in intensive and practical training. Learn to design sophisticated prompts, develop personalized solutions and automate complex workflows. Based on real scenarios and interactive exercises, this session allows you to refine your skills through concrete workshops and immersive simulations.
formations.resources: Course materials, unlimited access to a professional AI tools suite, 6 months of mentoring
learnList: Master advanced prompt engineering and its optimizations.
Customize generative AI tools to meet your specific needs.
Create automations of your processes with high-performance AI tools.
public_cible: Business Leaders and Strategists: Integrate advanced AI for strategic decisions and productivity gains with advanced use cases.
Executives and Managers: Design and refine effective prompts that improve results and optimize work time.

Freelancers and Entrepreneurs: Acquire specific skills to stand out through our introduction to prompt engineering. Develop skills to train and support businesses on generative AI. Content creation and specialized workshop facilitation.
Researchers and Master's/PhD Students: Deepen knowledge for research projects. Access to the latest techniques and resources to publish work with tools such as Perplexity.
prerequisites: Professionals wishing to integrate generative AI into their projects.
